# Design

server/stores/routines.ts holds the pure schedule maths and the store: parseTime, lastScheduledBefore, nextScheduledAfter, isDue with GRACE_MS 2 h, normalize with MAX_ROUTINE_PROMPT 2000 and MAX_ROUTINES 50, describe for summaries, beginRun/endRun with MAX_RUNS 20, settleOrphanRuns at boot, removeForTarget on deletion; routines.json under ~/.workmates written 0o600 and re-validated by isRoutine on load. server/index.ts runs runDueRoutines every 30 s plus once 5 s after boot: room targets post the prompt to the room, agent targets reuse or create an idle lane titled Routines via backgroundTaskId without activating it, markRan happens before startTurn, openRuns maps lane to run and the turn.completed fold closes it with the last bot message and a routine.ran ledger entry. Routes: GET/POST /api/routines, PATCH/DELETE /api/routines/:id, POST /api/routines/:id/run; broadcasts kind routines, which the panels refetch on rather than fold. UI: AutomationsPanel.tsx Schedules tab (day/week/month, 06:00 to 23:00 gutter, now line, drag with a 5 px threshold snapped to 15 min, RoutineDetails with RunHistory), RoutinesDialog.tsx (list and create form), RoutinesSection.tsx (the per-agent block in ComputerPanel, also opened pinned from RoomView).
